name: University of Memphis
academic_ranking: Public research university (R1/Carnegie high research activity). Fall 2024 admissions per NCES College Navigator: acceptance rate ~72% (15,084 applicants), test-optional. Middle-50% ACT Composite 18-24 (median 21); SAT EBRW 480-600, SAT Math 435-580. Most enrolled students submit ACT scores.
financial_aid: Public university; in-state tuition & fees ~$10,728 and out-of-state ~$15,384 (NCES College Navigator, 2024-25). Athletic aid administered through Memphis Athletics; academic and need-based aid via the Office of Student Financial Aid (901-678-4825). Tuition figure stored is the out-of-state published rate.
facilities_notes: Home venue is the Tigers Softball Complex. 2016 renovations funded largely by the Helen and Jabie Hardin Charitable Trust added a 10,000-sq-ft complex addition with coaches' offices, coaches' locker room, team meeting room, training room, indoor hitting and pitching area, laundry room and storage; a separate ~5,000-sq-ft indoor training facility (two hitting/pitching cages, team lounge, coaching offices) opened January 2016. 2026 was the program's first ticketed season, with a record attendance of 551 vs. Oklahoma on March 18, 2026; temporary bleachers beyond the outfield wall added for marquee games. Source: gotigersgo.com facilities page, checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I program competing in the American Athletic Conference. Growing program that reached a milestone with its first ticketed season and record on-campus attendance in 2026, hosting Power-conference opponents (Oklahoma, Ole Miss). Reputation based on official athletics site content; no championship claims verified.
notes: Researched live from gotigersgo.com softball coaches and roster pages on 2026-07-30. Coaches staff page is JavaScript-rendered; data extracted from the server-rendered staff table (2 tables: 4 coaching staff, 5 softball-support staff). No phone numbers are publicly listed for any staff member. Note: an earlier plain curl of the coaches URL followed a redirect into a shared Sidearm template for a different school (Ohio Dominican) whose data was discarded; the profile below uses only verified @memphis.edu records. Tuition and academic profile sourced from NCES College Navigator (id 220862), 2024-25. Roster size counted from 25 unique player links on the softball roster page.
